text:
Ella (People Ops): Heads-up - Min in Singapore has a travel-ban stamped passport and the background vendor wants an apostille for the degree. Day-1 orientation is set for Mon 9/12 08:00 PT. Min says passport renewal timeline is 3 weeks and apostille will take 7-10 business days.

Min (new-hire): Hi all - I can request expedited passport, but the university issues apostilles only by mail. I have a scanned diploma and an attestation letter from the registrar.

Jules (Background): Vendor requires either an apostille OR notarized attestation + certified translation if doc isn't in English. Attestation letter MAY be acceptable with notarized selfie. Please upload docs to portal.

Harrison - Hiring Manager: If clearance will take that long, can we delay start? We need Min to join for the sprint kickoff but can accommodate a 2-week push if needed.

Ella (People Ops): Proposal: keep remote orientation as tentative 9/12 but set official start to 9/26 if docs not cleared by 9/11 EOD PT. Min, can you upload scanned diploma, attestation_letter.pdf and a selfie with your ID by 9/8?

Min (new-hire): I can upload scanned diploma + attestation by tonight. I can also arrange a local notary for the attestation on 9/7.

Kara (Benefits): Note on contractors vs full-time: if Min converts from contractor to hire within 30 days, benefits effective date may change. For now, contractors get prorated commuter allowance and access to voluntary plans only. Stipend window is 14 days from official start. If start moves >7 days, manager approval needed to extend.

Harrison - Hiring Manager: Approve up to 10 day extension for stipend window if we push. We prefer Min to start prior to sprint but not at the risk of non-clearance.

IT Logistics: Laptop hold created under ticket `IT-9981`. For international addresses expect extra customs time. Please DM shipping address. Standard ship ETA 5-7 business days.

ShipBot: Label prepared TRACK-SG-998. Estimated delivery 2024-09-10 via OceanEx (note: customs delay possible).

Ella (People Ops): Checklist for clarity:

```
- Upload: diploma_scan.pdf, attestation_letter.pdf, selfie_with_ID.jpg by 2024-09-08 EOD PT
- Arrange local notary for attestation on 2024-09-07
- Vendor re-run clearance ETA 24-72h after docs received
- Tentative remote orientation 2024-09-12 08:00 PT (will be confirmed on clearance)
- If not cleared by 2024-09-11 EOD PT -> official start 2024-09-26
- Manager-approved stipend extension up to 10 days if start delayed
- IT to ship laptop once address confirmed (customs may add 3-5 days)
```

Min (new-hire): Uploaded diploma_scan.pdf and attestation_letter.pdf to portal. Booked notary for 9/07 14:00 SGT. Thank you!

Jules (Background): Received files. Starting expedited review now. I'll update when vendor confirms whether attestation + selfie suffices or an apostille is mandatory.

Ella (People Ops): Great. I'll tentatively leave the 9/12 invite and mark it 'virtual watch-only' until Jules confirms. Harrison please confirm if you'd like Min to attend sprint kickoff even if still pending clearance.

Harrison - Hiring Manager: Let Min join the kickoff as observer on 9/12. Once cleared we'll switch to active contributor. Thanks team.

Jules (Background): Vendor accepted notarized attestation + selfie as a temporary clearance pending apostille. Full clearance will be recorded after apostille arrives. All green for provisional onboarding.

Ella (People Ops): Fantastic 44d. Final plan summarized: provisional start 2024-09-12 (observer), full clearance pending apostille; stipend window to be active from final confirmed start date; IT to proceed with shipping on address confirmation. I'll send DM with shipping form and benefits notes.

Min (new-hire): Appreciate everyone's help 60a. See you on 9/12.
